note: Triennial election of the fourteen district electoral divisions of Ballycastle rural district, one member each. Nominations were lodged on 7 May 1924: four divisions were contested and the other ten were unopposed returns (Belfast News-Letter, 9 May 1924). The four contests were polled on Thursday 5 June and declared on 6 June. The fourteenth division, Dunseverick, is omitted: the candidate's surname is cut off in the only printed list traced (James M'N...), and is not guessed. Sole nomination (Nationalist); retiring member. Returned unopposed.
